features.title: Continuous discovery
features.text: VaultScan maps your full attack surface — cloud, containers, APIs, and on-prem — and rescans on every change, not on a schedule.

settings.title: Straight answers,
settings.intro: The questions security and engineering leaders ask us most.

items.question: How is VaultScan different from a traditional vulnerability scanner?
items.answer: Traditional scanners hand you a raw list of thousands of CVEs. VaultScan ranks every finding by real-world exploitability and reachability, then turns the top risks into a fix-first roadmap your team can actually execute. You get fewer, better alerts — not more noise.

items.question: Do you need agents on our production servers?
items.answer: No. VaultScan works with read-only credentials and non-intrusive scanning. We map your cloud, containers, and exposed services without installing anything on your production infrastructure.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Most teams are scanning their full attack surface within 30 minutes. Connect your cloud accounts and repos, and we handle discovery and continuous rescanning from there.

items.question: Is VaultScan compliant with SOC 2 and GDPR?
items.answer: Yes. VaultScan is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR-ready. We also generate one-click compliance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS from your scan data.

items.question: What happens to our data?
items.answer: Your scan data is encrypted in transit and at rest, isolated per tenant, and never used to train models or shared with third parties. You can export or delete it at any time.
